title: Concept: Cache statistics in a response
description: A hit rate and an eviction counter in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The rate shows how much of the traffic is served from memory, which tells an attacker when a cache-busting parameter will hurt most.
applicability: Deployments that render a hit rate and an eviction counter into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The rate shows how much of the traffic is served from memory, which tells an attacker when a cache-busting parameter will hurt most.
